objective: Definir y certificar en READ_ONLY el flujo funcional posterior a Gate12I para vincular membresias Cava existentes y nuevas con Gobierno_Persona, reutilizando Gobierno_PersonaVinculo y Cliente_Catalogo sin crear identidades paralelas. Auditar el CRUD actual de Cavas, promover/sincronizar clientes canonicos, repositorio Catalogo Ampliado, RBAC existente y el estado fisico SQL de los 2 socios actuales. Determinar el contrato minimo para alta, vinculacion, desvinculacion controlada, promocion a cliente y compatibilidad legacy. No modificar codigo, SQL, permisos, secrets ni Produccion.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS db_user, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: current_cava_socios
queries.sql: SELECT SocioID,EmpresaID,NumeroSocio,NombreCompleto,Email,Telefono,ClienteCRMID,PersonaID,Estatus FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios ORDER BY EmpresaID,NumeroSocio,SocioID;

queries.name: persona_link_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios, SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_sin_persona, SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_schema
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo') AND i.is_hypothetical=0 ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: existing_personas
queries.sql: SELECT PersonaID,Nombre,ApellidoPaterno,ApellidoMaterno,RFC,CURP,Activo FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona ORDER BY PersonaID;

queries.name: existing_persona_vinculos
queries.sql: SELECT VinculoID,PersonaID,UsuarioID,ClienteID,ProveedorID,ContactoClienteID,ContactoProveedorID,EsPrincipal,Activo FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo ORDER BY VinculoID;

queries.name: cliente_catalogo_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT ClienteID,Nombre,RFC,Email,Telefono,Activo FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo ORDER BY ClienteID;
